summary: Etsy filed an 8-K reporting completion of the sale of Depop Limited to eBay Inc. for approximately $1.4 billion in cash, reflecting the $1.2 billion purchase price plus $200 million net purchase price adjustments and interest. The sale closed on July 30, 2026, following a February 2026 agreement and subsequent amendments. Etsy also amended its credit agreement to permit the disposition. Post-closing adjustments remain possible. Watch for potential working capital or tax adjustments and use of proceeds, as well as any regulatory or antitrust scrutiny of the acquisition.
